name: test_unload_module_rust
description: The RUST-FIRST half of the teardown contract: the same three cases as test_unload_module_cpp (Synchronous, Asynchronous-then-finishing, Asynchronous-then-never-finishing), chosen at runtime from LOGOS_UNLOAD_MODE. A rust-first module reaches the hook by implementing logos_rust_sdk::AboutToUnload and installing with logos_install!, so this fixture is also the only end-to-end proof that that door works.
author: Logos Core Team
